_comment: Bosses that are not there on every run, keyed by name. chance = share of runs in which you get to fight this boss. basis: 'mechanic' = follows from how the encounter works in the original game (one of N random bosses); 'kills' = Wowhead's recorded kills of this boss compared with the most-killed boss of the same dungeon part, read on 2026-11-22; 'estimate' = a guess for a rare spawn nobody has numbers for.
